Calculates voxel coordinates from a matrix where values indicate height above the ground.

Parameters include `mat` (integer matrix), `fill` (color matrix, optional), `scale` (default 1), `flipx` (default FALSE), `flipy` (default TRUE), `ground` (default 'xy'), `solid` (default TRUE, expensive), and `check_visibility` (default FALSE).
